metadata.title: A statistical model for tensor PCA

nodes.name: Spiked Tensor Model
nodes.statement: Observation model: $\bX = \beta\, \bvz^{\otimes k} + \bZ$, where $\bvz \in \bbS^{n-1}$ is the unknown signal, $\beta$ is the signal-to-noise ratio, and $\bZ$ is a symmetric Gaussian noise tensor.
nodes.statement_clean: A rank-one-plus-noise tensor model: a $k$-th order tensor equals $\beta$ times a rank-one symmetric tensor built from an unknown unit vector $\bvz$, plus symmetric Gaussian noise.

nodes.name: Symmetric standard normal noise tensor
nodes.statement: $\bZ = \frac{1}{k!}\sqrt{\frac{k}{n}} \sum_{\pi \in \mathfrak{S}_k} \bG^\pi$, where $\bG \in \bigotimes^k \reals^n$ has i.i.d. $\normal(0,1)$ entries.

nodes.name: Tensor operator norm
nodes.statement: $\|\bX\|_{op} \equiv \max\{\<\bX, \bu_1 \otimes \cdots \otimes \bu_k\> : \forall i \in [k], \|\bu_i\|_2 \le 1\}$.

nodes.name: Tensor-vector product map
nodes.statement: For a tensor $\bX \in \bigotimes^k \reals^n$ and $\bv \in \reals^n$: $\bX\{\bv\}_i = \sum_{j_1,\dots,j_{k-1} \in [n]} \bX_{i,j_1,\dots,j_{k-1}} \bv_{j_1}\cdots\bv_{j_{k-1}}$.

nodes.name: Loss function for sign-symmetric estimator
nodes.statement: $\Loss(\hbv,\bvz) \equiv \min(\|\hbv-\bvz\|_2^2, \|\hbv+\bvz\|_2^2) = 2 - 2|\<\hbv,\bvz\>|$.

nodes.name: Unfolding (matricization) operator $\M_q$
nodes.statement: $\M_q : \otimes^k \reals^n \to \reals^{n^q \times n^{k-q}}$ is defined by $[\M_q(\bX)]_{a,b} = \bX_{i_1,\dots,i_k}$ where $a = 1+\sum_{j=1}^q (i_j-1) n^{j-1}$ and $b = 1+\sum_{j=q+1}^k (i_j-1) n^{j-q-1}$.

nodes.name: Random cost function $H_\bZ$ (spherical $p$-spin)
nodes.statement: $H_\bZ : \bbS^{n-1} \to \reals$, $H_\bZ(\bv) \equiv \<\bZ, \bv^{\otimes k}\>$.

nodes.name: PSD-cone-constrained principal component
nodes.statement: $(\hbw,\hbv) \equiv \arg\max\{\<\bw, \M(\bX)\bv\> : \mathtt{reshape}_{n\times n}(\bw) \succeq 0, \|\bw\|_2 \le 1, \|\bv\|_2 \le 1\}$.

nodes.name: Desired local optimum (AMP)
nodes.statement: $\{\bv^t\}_t$ converges almost surely to a desired local optimum if a.s. $\lim_{t\to\infty}\lim_{n\to\infty} \Loss(\bv^t/\|\bv^t\|_2, \bvz) \le 6/\beta^2$.

nodes.name: Tensor PCA
nodes.statement: $\text{maximize}\;\<\bX, \bv^{\otimes k}\>\;\text{subject to}\;\|\bv\|_2 = 1$. The maximum-likelihood estimator $\hbv^{\sML}$ is a solution.
nodes.statement_clean: Find a unit vector that maximizes the multilinear form $\<\bX, \bv^{\otimes k}\>$; this is NP-hard in general.

nodes.name: Spiked-tensor signal recovery with side information
nodes.statement: Recover $\bvz$ given $\bX = \beta \bvz^{\otimes k} + \bZ$ together with side information $\by = \gamma \bvz + \bz$, $\bz \sim \normal(0, \id_n/n)$.

nodes.name: Information-theoretic lower bound
nodes.statement: For any unit-norm estimator $\hbv : \otimes^k \reals^n \to \bbS^{n-1}$ and $n \ge 4$: $\beta \le \sqrt{k/10} \Rightarrow \E\,\Loss(\hbv,\bvz) \ge 1/32$.

nodes.name: Operator norm of symmetric Gaussian noise tensor
nodes.statement: There exists a sequence $\{\mu_k\}_{k\ge 2}$ with $\mu_k = \sqrt{k\log k}(1+o_k(1))$ such that $\limsup_{n\to\infty}\|\bZ\|_{op} \le \mu_k$ ($k$ odd) or $\lim_{n\to\infty}\|\bZ\|_{op} = \mu_k$ ($k$ even), with concentration $\prob(|\|\bZ\|_{op} - \E\|\bZ\|_{op}| \ge s) \le 2 e^{-ns^2/(2k)}$.
assumptions: $\bZ$ symmetric standard normal noise tensor of order $k$

nodes.name: Maximum-likelihood error bound (nonconvex optimization)
nodes.statement: For $\beta \ge \mu_k$ and large $n$: $\Loss(\hbv^{\sML},\bvz) \le \frac{2}{\beta}(\mu_k + s)$ with probability at least $1 - 2e^{-ns^2/(16k)}$.

nodes.name: Sudakov-Fernique upper bound on $\E\|\bX\|_{op}$
nodes.statement: Under the Spiked Tensor Model: $\limsup_{n\to\infty} \E\|\bX\|_{op} \le \max_{\tau \ge 0}\{\beta(\tau/\sqrt{1+\tau^2})^k + k/\sqrt{1+\tau^2}\}$, with concentration $\prob(|\|\bX\|_{op}-\E\|\bX\|_{op}| \ge s) \le 2e^{-ns^2/(2k)}$.

nodes.name: Operator-norm bound for unfolded noise $\M_q(\bZ)$
nodes.statement: For any $0 \le q \le k$: $\frac{n^{\max(q-1,k-q-1)/2}}{\sqrt{(k-1)!}}(1-C_k/n^{\max(q,k-q)}) \le \E\|\M_q(\bZ)\|_{op} \le \sqrt{k}(n^{(q-1)/2}+n^{(k-q-1)/2})$. Both bounds are minimized at $q=\lceil k/2 \rceil$, with concentration $\prob(|\|\M_q(\bZ)\|_{op}-\E\|\M_q(\bZ)\|_{op}| \ge t) \le 2e^{-nt^2/(2k)}$.
assumptions: $\bZ$ symmetric standard normal noise tensor of order $k$
conclusions: Both bounds minimized at $q = \lceil k/2 \rceil$ for $n$ large

nodes.name: Wedin perturbation theorem
nodes.statement: Let $\bM = \beta \buz \bwz^\sT + \bE \in \reals^{m\times p}$ with $\|\buz\|_2 = \|\bwz\|_2 = 1$; let $\hbw$ be the right singular vector of $\bM$. If $\beta > 2\|\bE\|_{op}$, then $\Loss(\hbw,\bwz) \le 8\|\bE\|_{op}^2/\beta^2$.

nodes.name: Tensor unfolding success threshold
nodes.statement: Let $\bw(\bX)$ be the top right singular vector of $\M(\bX)$ with $q = \lceil k/2 \rceil$ and $b = (\lceil k/2 \rceil - 1)/2$. If $\beta \ge 5 k^{1/2} n^b$, then with probability $\ge 1-n^{-2}$: $\Loss(\bw, \vec(\bvz^{\otimes \lfloor k/2 \rfloor})) \le C k n^{2b}/\beta^2$.
assumptions: Spiked Tensor Model with symmetric Gaussian noise $\bZ$
conclusions: With probability $\ge 1-n^{-2}$: $\Loss(\bw, \vec(\bvz^{\otimes \lfloor k/2\rfloor})) \le C_k k n^{2b}/\beta^2$

nodes.name: Recursive unfolding under asymmetric noise (sharp threshold)
nodes.statement: For non-symmetric noise $\btX = \beta \bvz^{\otimes k} + \bG/\sqrt{n}$ with $k \ge 4$ even and $b = (k-2)/4$: if $\beta \ge (1+\eps) n^b$ then a.s. $\lim_{n\to\infty} \Loss(\hbv,\bvz) = 0$, where $\hbv$ is the recursive-unfolding estimator.

nodes.name: Power iteration convergence
nodes.statement: Assume $\beta \ge 2e(k-1)\|\bZ\|_{op}$ and $\<\by,\bvz\>/\|\by\|_2 \ge [(k-1)\|\bZ\|_{op}/\beta]^{1/(k-1)}$. Then for all $t \ge t_0(k)$: $\Loss(\bv^t,\bvz) \le 2e\|\bZ\|_{op}/\beta$. For standard normal $\bZ$, both conditions hold w.h.p. provided $\beta \ge 2ek\mu_k$ and $\<\by,\bvz\>/\|\by\|_2 \ge (k\mu_k/\beta)^{1/(k-1)}$.
conclusions: For standard normal $\bZ$, conditions hold w.h.p. with $\beta \ge 2ek\mu_k = 6\sqrt{k^3 \log k}(1+o_k(1))$

nodes.name: AMP state evolution
nodes.statement: Let $\bv^t$ be the AMP iterate with side info $\by = \gamma \bvz + \bz$, $\bz \sim \normal(0,\id_n/n)$. Decomposing $\bv^t = \bv^t_\parallel + \bv^t_\perp$, the perpendicular part is uniformly random conditional on its norm, and a.s. $\lim_n \<\bv^t,\bvz\> = \tau_t$, $\lim_n \|\bv^t_\perp\|_2 = 1$, with $\tau_0 = \gamma$ and $\tau_{t+1}^2 = \beta^2 (\tau_t^2/(1+\tau_t^2))^{k-1}$.
conclusions: $\bv^t_\perp$ uniformly random conditional on its norm

nodes.name: AMP convergence threshold (with side information)
nodes.statement: For $k \ge 3$ and $\beta > \omega_k \equiv \sqrt{(k-1)^{k-1}/(k-2)^{k-2}} \sim \sqrt{ek}$, AMP converges a.s. to a desired local optimum iff $\gamma > \sqrt{1/\epsilon_k(\beta) - 1}$, where $\epsilon_k(\beta)$ is the largest solution of $(1-\epsilon)^{k-2}\epsilon = \beta^{-2}$.
conclusions: AMP converges a.s. to a desired local optimum iff $\gamma > \sqrt{1/\epsilon_k(\beta) - 1}$

nodes.name: Auffinger-Ben Arous-Cerny complexity formula
nodes.statement: For any $k \ge 3$: $\lim_{n\to\infty} (1/n) \log \E\,{\sf C}_k(\bZ_n,x) = g_k(x)$, where for $x \ge \eta_k = 2\sqrt{k-1}$: $g_k(x) = \frac{1}{2}\{\frac{2-k}{k} - \log(kz^2/2) + \frac{k-1}{2}z^2 - 2/(k^2 z^2)\}$ with $z = \frac{1}{(k-1)\sqrt{2k}}(x - \sqrt{x^2 - 4(k-1)})$.
nodes.origin_citation: Auffinger, Ben Arous, Cerny 2013 (Theorem 2.5 and Lemma 6.3)

nodes.name: Convergence of $\E\|\bZ\|_{op}$ to $\mu_k$
nodes.statement: Let $\mu_k$ be the unique non-negative root of $g_k(x) = 0$ for $x \ge \eta_k$. Then $\lim_{n\to\infty} \E\|\bZ\|_{op} = \mu_k$.

nodes.name: KL bound between conditional laws
nodes.statement: For any $\bw, \bw' \in \bbS^{n-1}$: $D(P_\bw \Vert P_{\bw'}) \le 2(n/k)\beta^2$, where $P_\bw$ is the law of $\sU(\bX)$ conditional on $\bvz = \bw$.

nodes.name: Uniform norm convergence for Gaussian shift
nodes.section: Appendix B.3 Proof of Lemma upperBoundX
nodes.statement: For $\bg \sim \normal(0,\id_n/n)$ and $\|\bvz(n)\|_2 = 1$, there exists $\delta_n \to 0$ such that almost surely, for $n \ge n_0$: $\sup_{\tau \in [0,\tau_{\max}]} |\,\|\bg + \tau\bvz\|_2 - \sqrt{1+\tau^2}\,| \le \delta_n$.

nodes.name: Tensor Unfolding (matrix PCA on $\M_q(\bX)$)
nodes.statement: Form the matricization $\M_q(\bX) \in \reals^{n^q \times n^{k-q}}$ with $q = \lceil k/2 \rceil$, take its top right singular vector as estimate of $\vec(\bvz^{\otimes \lceil k/2\rceil})$.

nodes.name: Recursive unfolding
nodes.statement: Two-step unfolding: take top singular vector of $\M(\bX)$, reshape it as $\M_1(\bw) \in \reals^{n \times n^{2b}}$, take its left principal vector as estimate $\hbv$.

nodes.name: Tensor power iteration
nodes.statement: Iterate $\bv^{t+1} = \bX\{\bv^t\}/\|\bX\{\bv^t\}\|_2$, starting from $\bv^0 = \by/\|\by\|_2$.

nodes.name: Warm-start power iteration
nodes.statement: Initialize tensor power iteration with $\bv^0 = \hbv^{\rm Unfold}$ from tensor unfolding, then iterate.

nodes.name: Approximate Message Passing (AMP) for tensor PCA
output: Iterates $\bv^t$ converging to a fixed point of state evolution

nodes.name: PSD-cone-constrained projected power iteration
nodes.statement: Random init $\bu^0 \in \reals^n$; for $t \ge 0$: $\bw^t = \P(\M(\bX)\bv^t)$ then $\bv^{t+1} = \M(\bX)^\sT \bw^t/\|\M(\bX)^\sT \bw^t\|_2$, where $\P$ is the orthogonal projector onto the PSD cone in $\reals^{n^2}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (information-theoretic lower bound)
nodes.statement: Fano's-inequality / packing argument: bound $D(P_\bw\Vert P_{\bw'})$, use a packing of $\bbS^{n-1}$, apply Markov to convert error probability to expected loss.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma upperBoundMatricized (operator norm of $\M_q(\bZ)$)
nodes.statement: Concentration via Lipschitz bound and Gaussian isoperimetry; upper bound via triangular inequality over permutation symmetrization; lower bound by Frobenius-norm comparison and concentration.

nodes.name: Proof of Wedin perturbation theorem
nodes.statement: Apply Wedin's $\sin\theta$ bound, then use $|\cos(\hbw,\bwz)| \ge \sqrt{1 - 4\|\bE\|_{op}^2/\beta^2}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem unfold (unfolding success threshold)
nodes.statement: Decompose $\M(\bX) = \beta \buz \bwz^\sT + \M(\bZ)$ and apply Wedin's theorem with the noise bound from Lemma upperBoundMatricized.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem unfoldNonsymm (recursive unfolding)
nodes.statement: Use rotational invariance of $\bG$ to write $\bw(\btX) = \rho_n \vec(\bvz^{\otimes k/2}) + (\orho_n/n^{k/4})\bg$; control limits of $\rho_n,\orho_n$ via random matrix theory; apply Wedin to $\M_1(\bw)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem powerIterationPositiveResult
nodes.statement: Track $\tau_t = \<\bvz,\bv^t\>$; show inductively $\tau_t \ge \tau_{\rm min}$, derive $\tau_{t+1} \ge 1 - \xi/\tau_t^{k-1}$, study fixed-point map $f(x) = 1 - \xi x^{1-k}$, conclude exponential convergence to $\tau_*$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem AMPisGood
nodes.statement: Reparametrize $x = \tau^2/(1+\tau^2)$; reduce fixed-point equation to $h_k(x) = 1/\beta^2$ with $h_k(x) = x^{k-2}(1-x)$; analyze monotonicity to find two roots when $\beta>\omega_k$, show largest fixed point $\ge 1-2/\beta^2$, then convert via state evolution.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem nonconvexOpt (ML upper bound)
nodes.statement: By optimality of $\hbv^{\sML}$: $\<\bvz,\hbv\>^k \ge 1 - (1/\beta)(\|\bZ\|_{op} - \<\bZ,\bvz^{\otimes k}\>)$; apply Gaussian isoperimetry on the Lipschitz functional and use $(1-\alpha)^{1/k} \ge 1-\alpha$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma upperBoundX (Sudakov-Fernique)
nodes.statement: Slice the sphere by $\<\bv,\bvz\> = \kappa$, prove $\kappa \mapsto M_\bX(\kappa)$ is uniformly continuous, apply Gaussian concentration on a grid, then use Sudakov-Fernique by comparing to a centered Gaussian process indexed by $\bv \in \cW_\kappa$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma Kullback (KL bound)
nodes.statement: Identify $P_\bw$ as a Gaussian with mean $\beta \sU(\bw^{\otimes k})$ and isotropic covariance, compute KL via Frobenius distance, use $\|\sU(\bW)\|_2^2 \le \|\bW\|_F^2/k!$ and $\|\bw^{\otimes k} - \bw'^{\otimes k}\|_F^2 = 2(1-\<\bw,\bw'\>^k)$.

nodes.name: Numerical comparison of algorithms ($k=3$)
nodes.statement: For $k=3$, $n \in \{25,50,100,200,400,800\}$, $\beta \in [2,10]$: compares unfold, recursive unfold, PSD s.v., tensor power iteration with random/unfold/PSD/recursive-unfold initializations. Findings: unfolding-based methods dominate random init; recursive processing improves accuracy above threshold.

nodes.name: Scaling of threshold SNR with $n$
nodes.statement: Empirical scaling test: plot $|\<\hbv,\bvz\>|$ versus $\beta/n^{1/2}$ (power iteration) and $\beta/n^{1/4}$ (unfolding); curves superpose for $n \ge 50$, confirming heuristic predictions.

nodes.name: Simultaneous matrix-and-tensor PCA at $\beta = 3$
nodes.statement: Tensor $\bX$ from spiked model ($k=3$, $\beta=3$) plus side observation $\bM = \lambda \bvz \bvz^\sT + \bN$, $\lambda \in [0,2]$. Use leading eigenvector of $\bM$ to initialize AMP. AMP threshold given by $\gamma > \beta(1/2 - \sqrt{1/4 - 1/\beta^2})$ matches simulations for $n=500$.

nodes.name: Auffinger notation correspondence
nodes.statement: To match notations in [Auffinger13], rescale $H_{n,k}(\bv) = (n/\sqrt{k})\,L_\bZ(\bv/\sqrt{n})$.

nodes.name: Looseness of Sudakov-Fernique upper bound
nodes.statement: Setting $\beta = 0$ in Lemma upperBoundX yields the loose bound $\|\bZ\|_{op} \le k$, which is off by roughly $\sqrt{k}$ except in the $k=2$ case.

nodes.name: AMP solves Tensor PCA asymptotically
nodes.statement: Under the assumptions of Theorem AMPisGood, for $\beta > \beta_k$ sufficiently large, AMP asymptotically solves the Tensor PCA optimization: $\lim_t \lim_n |\<\bX,(\bv^t)^{\otimes k}\> - \|\bX\|_{op}| = 0$ a.s.

nodes.name: First-iteration distribution for power iteration
nodes.statement: $\bv^1 = (\beta\tau_0^{k-1}\bvz + n^{-1/2}\bg)/\sqrt{\beta^2\tau_0^{2(k-1)}+1} + \bo(1)$, hence $\ttau_1 = \beta\ttau_0^{k-1}/\sqrt{\beta^2 \ttau_0^{2(k-1)}+1} + o(1)$.

nodes.name: AMP state evolution recursion
nodes.statement: $\tau_{t+1}^2 = \beta^2 (\tau_t^2/(1+\tau_t^2))^{k-1}$ with $\tau_0 = \gamma$.

nodes.name: AMP fixed-point equation in $x = \tau^2/(1+\tau^2)$
nodes.statement: $1/\beta^2 = x^{k-2}(1-x) \equiv h_k(x)$, with maximum $1/\omega_k^2$ at $x_* = (k-2)/(k-1)$.

nodes.name: Pack the sphere
nodes.statement: Let $\cN$ be an $\eps$-packing of $\bbS^{n-1}$ with $|\cN| \ge N_n(\eps) \ge (1/\eps)^{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Markov: error probability bounds expected loss
nodes.statement: Define $G(\hbv(\bX)) = \arg\min_{\bw\in\cN}\|\hbv-\bw\|_2$. Then $\prob\{G \ne \bvz\} \le (4/\eps^2)\inf_\hbv \sup_\bvz \E\Loss$.

nodes.name: Apply Fano with KL bound
nodes.statement: Use Fano's inequality with $\Delta = \max D(P_\bw\Vert P_{\bw'}) \le 2n\beta^2/k$ from Lemma Kullback to bound $\prob\{G \ne \bvz\}$ from below.

nodes.name: Choose $\eps = 1/2$ and conclude
nodes.statement: For $\eps = 1/2$, $\beta \le \sqrt{k/10}$, $n \ge 4$: $\prob\{G \ne \bvz\} \ge 1/2$, so $\inf_\hbv \sup_\bvz \E\Loss \ge 1/32$.

nodes.name: Define $\tau_t = \<\bvz,\bv^t\>$ and noise ratio $\xi$
nodes.statement: Set $\xi = \|\bZ\|_{op}/\beta$; let $\tau_{\min}, \tau_*$ be the two solutions in $[0,1]$ of $\tau^{k-1}(1-\tau) = \xi$.

nodes.name: Inductive lower bound on $\tau_t$
nodes.statement: Use $\bX\{\bv^t\} = \beta\tau_t^{k-1}\bvz + \bZ\{\bv^t\}$ and triangular inequalities to get $\tau_{t+1} \ge (\tau_t^{k-1}-\xi)/(\tau_t^{k-1}+\xi)$, then $\tau_t \ge \ttau_t$ where $\ttau_{t+1} = 1 - \xi \ttau_t^{1-k}$.

nodes.name: Fixed-point analysis of $f(x) = 1 - \xi x^{1-k}$
nodes.statement: $f$ is concave monotone increasing on $[\tau_{\min},\tau_*]$ with $f'(\tau_{\min}) > 1$, $f'(\tau_*) < 1$, so $\ttau_t \to \tau_*$ exponentially.

nodes.name: Bound $\tau_*$ and $\tau_{\min}$ to extract loss bound
nodes.statement: For $\xi \le 1/(2e(k-1))$: $\tau_* > 1 - e\xi$ via $g_k(x) \ge e^{-1}(1-x)$; $\tau_{\min} < [(k-1)\xi]^{1/(k-1)}$ via $g_k(x) \ge x^{k-1}/(k-1)$. Specialize to standard normal $\bZ$ via Lemma BenArous.

nodes.name: Reparametrize fixed-point equation
nodes.statement: Set $x = \tau^2/(1+\tau^2) \in [0,1)$. Fixed-point becomes $1/\beta^2 = x^{k-2}(1-x) = h_k(x)$.

nodes.name: Two roots when $\beta > \omega_k$
nodes.statement: $h_k$ is continuously differentiable on $(0,1)$, $h_k(0)=h_k(1)=0$, with unique max $h_k(x_*) = 1/\omega_k^2$ at $x_* = (k-2)/(k-1)$. So $\beta > \omega_k$ gives two solutions $0<x_2(\beta)<x_*<x_1(\beta)<1$.

nodes.name: Lower bound on largest fixed point
State evolution + loss bound
nodes.statement: $\tau_t \to \tau_2$ with $\tau_2^2/(1+\tau_2^2) = x_2$, so $\Loss(\bv^t/\|\bv^t\|_2,\bvz) \to 2(1-\sqrt{x_2}) \le 2(1-x_2) \le 6/\beta^2$.

nodes.name: Decompose $\bw(\btX)$ along signal and noise
nodes.statement: By rotational invariance: $\bw(\btX) = \rho_n\,\vec(\bvz^{\otimes k/2}) + (\orho_n/n^{k/4})\bg$, $\bg \sim \normal(0,\id_{n^{k/2}})$.

nodes.name: Almost-sure limits of $\rho_n,\orho_n$
nodes.statement: From the Paul / Benaych-Georges-Nadakuditi phase transition: $\rho_n \to \sqrt{\eps/(1+\eps)}$, $\orho_n \to \sqrt{1/(1+\eps)}$ a.s.

nodes.name: Reshape and apply Wedin
nodes.statement: $\M_1(\bw) = \rho_n \bvz \bu^\sT + (\orho_n/n^{(2b+1)/2}) \bG'$ with i.i.d. Gaussian $\bG'$. Davidson-Szarek bound gives $\|\bG'\|_{op}/n^{(2b+1)/2} \le 2/\sqrt{n}$. Wedin then yields $|\<\hbv,\bvz\>| \to 1$.

nodes.name: Form matricization
nodes.statement: Compute $\M_q(\bX) \in \reals^{n^q \times n^{k-q}}$ with $q = \lceil k/2 \rceil$.

nodes.name: Top singular vector
nodes.statement: Compute the top right singular vector $\bw$ of $\M(\bX)$.

nodes.name: Return estimate
nodes.statement: Return $\bw$ as estimate of $\vec(\bvz^{\otimes \lceil k/2 \rceil})$.

nodes.name: First unfolding PCA
nodes.statement: Compute $\bw = $ top right singular vector of $\M(\btX)$.

nodes.name: Reshape singular vector
nodes.statement: Form $\M_1(\bw)_{i,j} = \bw_{i+(j-1)n} \in \reals^{n \times n^{2b}}$.

nodes.name: Second PCA on reshaped vector
nodes.statement: Set $\hbv$ = left principal vector of $\M_1(\bw)$. Return $\hbv$.

nodes.name: Initialize $\bv^0$
nodes.statement: $\bv^0 = \by/\|\by\|_2$, where $\by$ is the supplied initialization (random or warm-start).

nodes.name: Power iteration loop
nodes.statement: For $t = 0, 1, \dots$ (until convergence): $\bv^{t+1} = \bX\{\bv^t\}/\|\bX\{\bv^t\}\|_2$.

nodes.name: Return final iterate
nodes.statement: Return $\bv^t$ for $t \ge t_0(k)$.

nodes.name: AMP iteration with Onsager memory term
Return normalized iterate
nodes.statement: Return $\bv^t/\|\bv^t\|_2$ as estimate of $\bvz$.

nodes.name: Random initialization
nodes.statement: Sample $\bu^0 \in \reals^n$ uniformly at random, set $\bv^0$ accordingly.

nodes.name: Projected power iteration loop
nodes.statement: For $t \ge 0$: $\bw^t = \P(\M(\bX)\bv^t)$; $\bv^{t+1} = \M(\bX)^\sT \bw^t/\|\M(\bX)^\sT \bw^t\|_2$, where $\P$ projects onto the PSD cone in $\reals^{n^2}$.

nodes.name: Return PSD-constrained pair
nodes.statement: Return $(\hbw,\hbv)$ satisfying the cone-constrained optimum.
